Backflip: Expert Aerial Rotation

  • Outline: needs authoring
  • Class 3
  • Release C

For the reviewer

Reviewer needed
Expert aerial coach (verified specialist)
Status
Outline: needs authoring
Risk
Class 3: high-consequence skills
Text-verified source
No: the reviewer must supply or confirm the technical basis

The reviewer must supply or confirm:

  • Technique: specialist-authored theory review of each phase. No unsupervised drills, dimensions, speeds or “try this next”.
  • Progression: coach and facility pathway only.
  • Corrections: coach-approved.

Watch or read before signing off (not yet checked):

  • t01: How To Backflip Like A Pro (Could not be opened)
  • t02: Slopestyle: Advanced Drops and Jumps (Outline only)

Lesson goal

Theory only: what expert riders describe about the backflip’s phases, and the coach and facility pathway required before any attempt.

What it will cover

  • High-consequence warning: a written lesson cannot prepare a rider to attempt a backflip
  • Expert commentary and video breakdown
  • Physics visualisation of rotation
  • Coach and facility pathway: assessment, purpose-built environment, expert supervision, emergency plan, documented approval

Physics & maths

Rotation and moment of inertia: tucking speeds rotation up, extending slows it. Theory only.

Safety

Class 3: high-consequence skills. Theory and expert references only. Any practical progression is authored and supervised in person by a verified specialist coach, in a suitable facility.

Practice only on terrain your coach has chosen, within your current skill, with the right protective equipment. Completing a lesson isn’t a safety certificate and doesn’t mean a rider is ready to try anything.
